newsitem.title: USA: Golden Books Wisconsin workers OK wage cut.
newsitem.headline: Golden Books Wisconsin workers OK wage cut.

text.p: Golden Books Family Entertainment Inc said Thursday that employees at the company's Wisconsin manufacturing plant have voted to support a company-proposed 10 percent wage cut.
The plant in Racine, Wisconsin, has about 500 employees, spokeswoman Tracy Riefe said. Golden Books has fewer than 2,000 employees worldwide, Riefe said.
Golden Books shares were off 1/8 Thursday afternoon at 11-5/8.

Unions representing the Racine employees also approved higher employee contributions to the health plan and a two-tiered wage system as part of a proposed package intended to help Golden Books stay competitive, Riefe said.
In September Golden Books reported that second quarter losses had widened to a $5.07 per share loss from a $0.15 per share loss in the 1995 quarter.
The children's books publisher also had said it would take further writedowns in the third and fourth quarters.
